visual_elements.description: Full-slide blue-bordered grid: outer rectangle, vertical divider near 63% width, horizontal divider near 75% height.

Confusion matrix under red header 'Threshold=0.0'. Column header 'Predicted as' spans P and N; row axis label 'Actual' labels rows P and N. Cells: Actual P / Predicted P = 5 in blue, Actual P / Predicted N = 0, Actual N / Predicted P = 6 in red, Actual N / Predicted N = 0.

Confusion matrix under red header 'Threshold=0.1'. Column header 'Predicted as' spans P and N; row axis label 'Actual' labels rows P and N. Cells: Actual P / Predicted P = 5 in blue, Actual P / Predicted N = 0, Actual N / Predicted P = 4 in red, Actual N / Predicted N = 2 in blue.

ROC-style plot with vertical axis labeled TPR and horizontal axis labeled FPR. Red arrow axes originate from the lower-left. Light grid background, no numeric tick labels. Two open red circles near the top are labeled 0.1 on the left and 0.0 on the right. No connecting ROC line is drawn.
Blue-outlined box containing the title text 'ROC Curve for Same Model - different thresholds'.
Blue-outlined formula box containing stacked fraction equations TPR = TP/(TP+FN) and FPR = FP/(FP+TN).

2x2 legend matrix. Column header 'Predicted as' spans P and N; row label 'Actual' labels rows P and N. Cells: Actual P / Predicted P = TP in green, Actual P / Predicted N = FN, Actual N / Predicted P = FP, Actual N / Predicted N = TN in green.
Small yellow circular slide-number badge containing black bold text '30'.

imagery: Yellow circular slide-number badge containing '30' at the top-right corner.

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout, Arial-like. Headers, threshold labels, axis labels, and matrix headers are bold; cell values and formulas are regular. Acronyms are all caps: ROC, TPR, FPR, TP, FN, FP, TN. No bullet numbering is used.
animation_state: Static frame; no partially revealed build. A mouse-pointer arrow is visible in the capture near the lower matrix, but it is not slide content.
recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to white. 2. Add a blue structural grid: outer rectangle from about 11% to 95% width and 15% to 94% height, a vertical blue divider near 63% width, and a horizontal blue divider near 75% height; use blue #0000CC. 3. In the upper-left quadrant, build two confusion matrices. Give each a light-red header bar with dark-red bold text: upper 'Threshold=0.0', lower 'Threshold=0.1'. Under each, place 'Predicted as' above columns P and N, and 'Actual' as the row label for rows P and N. Upper matrix cells: P/P=5 in blue, P/N=0, N/P=6 in red, N/N=0. Lower matrix cells: P/P=5 in blue, P/N=0, N/P=4 in red, N/N=2 in blue. 4. To the right of each matrix, add black text: upper 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=6/(6+0)=1'; lower 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=4/(4+2)=0.66'. 5. In the lower-left quadrant, add a blue-outlined rectangle with dark-blue bold text 'ROC Curve for Same Model - different thresholds'. 6. In the upper-right quadrant, add a very light blue plot area with a light grid. Draw red arrow axes, label the vertical axis 'TPR' and the horizontal axis 'FPR'. Add two open red circles near the top; label the left circle '0.1' and the right circle '0.0'. Place a small yellow circle with black bold '30' at the top-right corner. 7. In the lower-right quadrant, add a blue-outlined formula box with stacked fractions 'TPR = TP/(TP+FN)' and 'FPR = FP/(FP+TN)'. To its right, add a 2x2 legend matrix with 'Predicted as' over P and N, 'Actual' beside rows P and N; fill TP and TN light green and leave FN and FP white; cell text TP, FN, FP, TN. 8. Keep all text verbatim, use sans-serif fonts, and do not add extra bullets or a diagonal ROC line.
